MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 15

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

4. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 6
   C. 18
   D. 13

5. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 121
   D. 22

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

8. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

9. Solve for x: x + 4 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 6

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

13. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 17
   C. 73
   D. 72

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

15. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 25
   C. 27
   D. 31

18. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

19. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

20. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

21. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

22. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 14

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

24. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
